title.narrative: Strengthening Journalists and Media Outlet Capacity and Preparedness for Disaster Communication in Maldives

description.narrative:
This activity will strengthen the capacity of media outlets in Maldives to plan, coordinate, and communicate more effectively on disasters, including early warning messages, life-saving information, and public advisories before, during, and after emergencies. It will also enhance their ability to identify and counter disinformation, uphold information integrity, and apply UNESCO’s model plan for disaster risk reduction in their preparedness and response arrangements.
This activity will also be implemented in close intersectorial collaboration with UNESCO’s science sector, particularly on disaster risk reduction, climate resilience, and the use of scientific evidence for risk communication. By connecting media capacity-building with scientific expertise, the activity will help ensure that public information on hazards, early warnings, and climate-related risks is accurate, timely, and aligned with UNESCO’s broader DRR and resilience agenda.
Key stakeholders will include media outlets, journalists, editors, and media associations, as well as national disaster management authorities, meteorological and climate institutions, and relevant government counterparts. The activity will also engage community representatives, civil society organizations, and UNESCO colleagues from the science and communication sectors to support coordinated, evidence-based disaster communication and information integrity.
